data.text:
GK-006 decision handover — interview-r1, 2026-10-05

Sasha confirmed in the decision interview:

1. Production deploys only from an explicitly authorized published component release. Merge/main CI never deploys production by itself.
2. A small staging environment hosts UI/backend with test data and sandbox payments, separate from production data/credentials. Every merge automatically reaches staging after successful CI on that exact main revision. Test before production release; a changed version requires staging verification again.
3. Sasha is the sole production-release approver. The agent can prepare releases and publish a specific version only after Sasha's explicit authorization. Sasha can also publish directly.
4. Checks + LOOP [independent specialist AI reviews in separate contexts → feedback → fixes → rerun affected checks/reviews] → native auto-merge. Select reviewer expertise for the areas touched. Failed required checks or unresolved blocking findings prevent merge; decisions needing Sasha return to Sasha. No routine human PR approval was selected.
5. ui-vX.Y.Z groups customer/admin interfaces; api-vX.Y.Z groups backend/background jobs. Independent releases require compatibility with the deployed counterpart; both may be authorized together.
6. Sasha administers repository/hosting/environments and controls access grants/revocation, with no additional routine human admins initially. Separate staging/production data and credentials and UI/API deployment permissions. PR checks/routine agent work receive no production secrets; authorized deployment jobs use protected scoped credentials. Private credentials never enter browser code. Existing business-owner billing/account identity/emergency recovery remains unchanged.

AC1 and AC3: explicit Creator decision evidence recorded locally with verbatim replies and hashes.
AC2 named limitation: github.com CLI verification returned HTTP 401, also without inherited token overrides. Repository plan, visibility, permissions, branch protections and native-auto-merge capability are UNVERIFIED. No bypass or alternative merge mechanism is approved. GK-013 must resolve access and prove gates using GK-020 B1 before GK-020 B2/native auto-merge proceeds. An AI review transcript is not proof of GitHub enforcement.
AC4: input/output fingerprints and same-session documentation checks accompany docs/creator/GK-006/. No independent review, application tests, configured protections or deployment evidence is claimed. Local files are in the current unpushed planning checkout; this summary carries the policy without relying on remote file access.

GK-019 reconciles the approved policy into downstream contracts/tickets; GK-013 verifies/configures gates; GK-020/GK-034 implement and verify automatic staging and release-only production. Use the already accepted test-runtime budget; no new spend is approved. Historical published ticket bodies are preserved.

Acceptance scope: Creator decision ticket, with the named AC2 verification limitation retained as a mandatory downstream gate. Infrastructure configuration, releases and deployment remain separate work. This handover authorizes no actual production release.

Readiness at publication: ready now for Creator action.

There is currently no application; this is an ordered planning packet. Confirm ordinary branch pushes run PR CI and production deploys only after an explicitly authorized published component release. Choose release publisher and required reviewer policy; native auto-merge waits for gates. No deployment or repository settings changed in this planning run.

Applicable common rules: server owns prices/availability/state; GBP integer pence, UTC instants plus Europe/London display and date semantics; role/ownership checked on every action; Idempotency-Key and expected_version protect repeated/stale mutations; pending external result is not success/failure. No network calls under database locks. Detailed requirements and tests below remain mandatory even if linked files change.

References: docs/design/contracts.md K09; docs/design/screens.md; docs/design/coverage.md; relevant docs/design/features/ packet; docs/planning/DELIVERY.md; SETUP.md. These are local unpushed planning artifacts; obtain this checkout's exact fingerprinted packet before execution.

## To dos

T1. Review current prerequisites and the concrete options/rules in Context; collect missing evidence (AC1).
T2. Perform only the Creator action described, recording settings/decision versions and safe nonsecret evidence (AC1–AC3).
T3. Check the acceptance examples, record remaining blockers and hand the approved output to dependent Agent tickets (AC3, AC4).

## Not to dos

Do not implement unrelated cleanup, register candidate alternatives, expose credentials, publish releases or deploy without the separate scoped authorization. Planning publication does not authorize application execution now. Do not mark Done without the board's acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1. Creator approves release-only deployment interpretation, authorized publishers and proposed ui-v/api-v naming or exact alternative.
AC2. Repository plan/permissions support required review/checks/native auto-merge or named limitation is recorded without bypass.
AC3. UI/API environment ownership and secret access separation are defined; release authorization is distinct from merge.
AC4. Required acceptance evidence is tied to exact input/output revision, checked by the appropriate reviewer/Creator and recorded on Trello. For implementation include relevant tests, all related PRs, required review/checks, merge and main CI; authorized release/deployment/smoke only when separately in scope.

Verification: inspect the concrete decision/configuration and nonsecret evidence against AC1–AC3. No forced software red/green cycle for human work. Account creation follows accepted-provider gate; no secret values in Trello.
